name: Rabshakeh
summary: A man sent by Assyria's king with a huge army to Jerusalem. Standing outside the wall, he mocked King Hezekiah's faith in the LORD.

key_moments.title: Mocks Hezekiah's Trust
key_moments.description: Rabshakeh came from Lachish and stood at the upper pool's water channel. He asked what made Hezekiah so sure, scorned Egypt as a crushed reed, and even claimed the LORD had sent him to destroy the land.

key_moments.title: Shouting to the People
key_moments.description: Hezekiah's men begged Rabshakeh to speak Syrian, not the Jews' language. Instead he shouted to the people on the wall, telling them Hezekiah could not save them, but they did not answer him a word.

key_moments.title: Returns to His King
key_moments.description: Hezekiah hoped the LORD would rebuke Rabshakeh for mocking the living God, and Isaiah said not to fear his words. Rabshakeh went back to Assyria's king, who was fighting against Libnah.
